The HWPX renewal playbook update succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the legacy pytest suite is fully compatible with the new automation logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.79 across a 4-minute runtime. The pytest tool (v7.4.4) reported 100% success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with zero exceptions. While the mean reward is optimal, the lower judge_reward suggests potential for further refinement in playbook documentation or edge-case handling.
